terms.comment: The man who drives the herds (armenta) of cattle and horses; Lewis & Short sets him apart from the bubulcus, who ploughs with oxen.
Classically a bubulcus is a ploughman with his oxen; Lewis & Short finds the sense “herdsman” only after Augustus, in the Digest.

phrases.english: the African herdsman takes everything with him (as he roams the desert with his herd)

sources: Lewis & Short: armentarius · Lewis & Short: bubulcus
